benefits.claim: The visual Kanban boards provide an intuitive way to organize tasks, track progress, and gain a clear overview of projects.
The interface is user-friendly and simple, making it easy to get started and manage tasks without a steep learning curve.
Trello offers extensive customization options for boards and cards, allowing users to adapt it to various project needs and workflows.

frictions.claim: Boards can become crowded and overwhelming when managing very large or complex projects with numerous team members.
Some users desire more advanced features for time tracking, statistics, or data manipulation that Trello may not provide natively.
Accessing certain advanced customization options or integrations may require payment.
